page: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-192-metal-cd is a storage-optimized bare-metal server based on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1536 GB of memory, resulting in an allocation of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities are anchored by 180389 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity. The platform operates without GPU acceleration hardware and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Operating as a dedicated bare-metal system, this configuration bypasses virtualization layers to deliver raw access to compute and storage resources. The substantial volume of local NVMe solid-state storage provides dense, low-latency disk capacity directly attached to the host. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dense aggregation of massive local NVMe storage and large memory capacity minimizes the necessity for separate networked storage pools, though networking layers must be provisioned independently given the lack of included public IPv4 routing.

The platform is matched to input-output-intensive workloads that require substantial disk space and fast sequential or random read and write throughput. Typical deployment scenarios include very large distributed databases, in-memory databases requiring disk persistence, high-throughput extract-transform-load data pipelines, and distributed analytics systems.
description: Google Cloud Platform z4m-highmem-192-metal-cd is a storage-optimized bare-metal server built on the x86_64 architecture for high-density data workloads. The system provides 192 dedicated vCPUs along with 1536 GB of memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU profile. It integrates 180389 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage to support heavy transactional throughput and rapid data retrieval directly on the host. The instance does not feature GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By operating on bare-metal hardware without hypervisor interference, the server delivers consistent execution across all processor cores. This balanced hardware profile offers cost-effective local resource density for enterprise databases, distributed storage nodes, massive caching tiers, and large-scale batch processing pipelines.
